scope: Estimate for half the pizza from weighed edible ingredients. All listed ingredients included, no sides. Nutrients assumed retained because no cooking liquid or fat is discarded. Energy uses the pepperoni label and, for Fineli/AFCD entries, macro-derived Annex XIV factors (EU 1169/2011): 4 kcal/g protein and available carbohydrate, 9 fat, 2 fibre and 2.4 polyols. No cooked weight or glycaemic load is assumed.
